summary.text: Sandy Pinsonault is a Republican state representative from the Bennington-Rutland District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sandy Pinsonault was born in Rutland, Vermont.
Pinsonault's career experience includes working as a justice of the peace.
Pinsonault won the Republican primary in August 2024 and defeated incumbent Democrat Mike Rice in the November 2024 general election, 54.5 percent to 45.3 percent.
